meta.title: Notepad
meta.description: A per-workspace floating notepad in the session view. New segment cards lead the list; an empty title is just a placeholder until clicked. Click an index to select, drag to reorder, merge a selection, move between cards with the arrow keys, and improve only the selected cards with AI — the button turns into undo and identical content reuses the previous answer. Paste or pick images as path-based chips; removing a chip cleans up plugin-owned files. Pending counts appear on the hidden launcher and the sidebar workspace row. Insert, replace, or send one or many; sending archives automatically. Archived segments can be shown, hidden, restored, and deleted. Auto refresh keeps the list scroll position, Ctrl+Shift+0 resets the panel geometry, the panel never covers the host title bar, and it is resizable and dark-mode aware.
